title: get_deployments input
description: What runs where? The latest version per application and target, or the history (latestOnly false), with flags. Filters by application, target, change request, result, dates, any flag or named flags. Writes nothing.

portfolioId.description: Only the applications in this portfolio, child portfolios included.

changeRequestId.description: Only the records matched to this change.

latestOnly.description: True returns only the latest record per application and target.

flaggedOnly.description: True returns only records with at least one flag: outside window, other path, missing approval or AI-only code approval.

flagKeys.description: Only records with at least one of these flags.

from.description: Finished on or after this date.

to.description: Finished on or before this date.
